name: B10-0036/2024 (PPE) – Continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on European Union countries to keep giving Ukraine money and weapons for as long as it takes. It asks them to lift limits on how Ukraine can use the weapons they supply, so Ukraine can hit targets inside Russia. It also wants countries to spend at least 0.25% of their yearly economic output on military help for Ukraine, and to keep sanctioning Russia.

- The Parliament asks countries to lift weapon-use limits and raise military aid; this affects Ukraine and European Union governments.
- It wants Russia's frozen assets used for Ukraine and a new court for aggression crimes; this affects Russia and Ukraine.
- It asks for more sanctions on Russia, including a ban on Russian potash; this affects European Union importers and Russia.
